COMPLETION EVIDENCE (round 2) — verbatim command output, so no re-derivation is needed.
Verified at origin/main, which now contains this work (origin/main == gerrit/main, and
src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_ac_satisfiability.md is present there).

--- AC: "No src/rebar/**/*.py file exceeds the 800-LOC cap" ---
Ran exactly what the CI Module-size gate runs (LIMIT=800 from .github/module-size-limit.txt):
  find src/rebar -name '*.py' | grep -v __pycache__ | xargs wc -l
    | awk -v lim=800 '$2 != "total" && $1 > lim { print $1 " " $2 }'
  OUTPUT: (empty)  =>  no src/rebar/**/*.py file exceeds 800 LOC.
Largest three: 800 _engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_differ.py, 799 llm/plan_review/attest.py,
799 llm/plan_review/__init__.py — all at or under the cap.
Files this change touched: pass1.py 607, passes.py 786, registry.py 744,
fidelity_spot_eval.py 497, eval_solver.py 330.
TEST: tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py -> 4 passed
(test_limit_file_is_a_single_positive_int, test_no_src_module_over_the_hard_cap,
test_compute_over_cap_is_deterministic, test_allowlist_mechanism_removed).

--- AC: "exercised end to end through the Pass-1 single-turn chunk path against a FakeRunner" ---
TEST NAME: test_reaches_pass1_and_attributes
TEST FILE: tests/unit/test_ac_satisfiability_criterion.py
RESULT: PASSED (within "20 passed in 18.66s" covering that file and test_container_roster.py).
What it asserts concretely:
  - calls passes.pass1_chunk(runner, cfg, plan=<a plan whose AC demands "no file under src/
    matches P" while its Out of Scope keeps src/keeper.py matching P>,
    chunk=[registry.by_id()["ac-satisfiability"]])
  - asserts "ac-satisfiability" appears in the captured req.instructions => the rubric
    actually reached the finder call
  - asserts "quantif" appears in req.instructions.lower() => the set-quantification rubric
    text is present in what was sent
  - asserts [f["criteria"] for f in out] == [["ac-satisfiability"]] => the emitted finding
    survived Pass-1 criterion-attribution validation, which DROPS out-of-set tags, so a
    mis-registered id would yield [] here

--- AC: "make lint, make typecheck and pytest tests/unit all pass" ---
make lint      -> ruff check + ruff format --check pass; zizmor "No findings to report. Good
                  job! (1 suppressed)"; actionlint (all workflows) clean. EXIT 0.
make typecheck -> "mypy src/rebar" => "Success: no issues found in 389 source files". EXIT 0.
pytest tests/unit -> "5801 passed, 19 skipped in 768.22s (0:12:48)". 0 failed.
All three also ran inside the pre-commit hook when the commit was created and passed there
independently ("lint ... Passed", "typecheck ... Passed", "commit message (50/72 wrap) ... Passed").

Independent corroboration for the merged tree: Gerrit change 1021 merged as bd8dc713f with
Verified +1 (GitHub Actions run 30510156790, SUCCESS — full build/test/lint/typecheck) and
LLM-Review +1 (PASS, 3 advisory findings, non-blocking).
